title: Dirty check ignores registry/runs.tsv only if it is not the first changed file
affects: start of convert/morphometry (refuses to run; no data affected)
details: git status --porcelain output was stripped; the leading space of the first status code was lost and the path was cut wrong.

title: Morphometry fails on a ROI without cells (empty CellInstances table read as text)
affects: build_morphometric_results: ROI with 0 detections gets no feature row (error), its group is missing from the weighted table; cmjsc convert reported such an H5 as ok
details: pmc J0045: B9_x3421_x124_x4a_r_trace_2 (H5 num_detections=0, include_row=1) -> weighted 819 instead of 820 rows. Fixed in 1.0.3: empty tables numeric, 0-cell row, convert status empty_h5.

title: Morphometry cannot find special-trace masks (<roi>_special_trace_mask.tif)
affects: build_morphometric_results: ROI with special_trace=1 gets no feature row (error "Unable to find file ..._mask.tif"); its group is missing from the weighted table (only_texture)
details: vsp 20261106_1133_morphometry: 6 of 500 ROIs (trace_type onlyouter1, special_trace=1, include_row=1) -> weighted 404 instead of 410 groups. JBA_TA names these masks <roi>_special_trace_mask.tif; one() in build_morphometric_results.m only tries <roi>_mask.tif. convert.py also assumes <roi>_mask.tif: archive_manifest.tsv mask_path points to a non-existent file, mask_sha256 empty (conversion itself unaffected).

title: convert keeps going when the H5 folder becomes unreachable and marks every remaining H5 as error
affects: cmjsc convert: after a network-drive outage all remaining H5 get status error (FileNotFoundError) within seconds; run ends partial, EXIT 1; no wrong data (errors are retried on resume)
details: bg 20261106_1040_J0042 session 1: L: unreachable at 14:31:40, 2558 of 4588 H5 marked error in ~80 s (2030 ok before). Resumed with the same --out (session 2).

title: JBA_TA masks (1-bit TIFF, WhiteIsZero) are read inverted outside MATLAB: JSC masked jobs keep the cells OUTSIDE the annotation
affects: convert/morphometry of every JSC job (and local cellseg --region-mask) that used JBA_TA *_mask.tif: cells are from the surrounding tissue, cells inside the annotation are missing; region area is the true annotation, so all cell features and densities are wrong. Special-trace masks (8-bit) are correct. cmjsc does not check that cells lie inside the mask.
details: Found 2026-11-09 (Alexey VSP J0037): 11/12 sampled ROIs have 99.8-100% of cell centroids outside the MATLAB mask, the special-trace ROI 99.9% inside; tifffile reads B1_x3211 cdm mask with 95.75% true vs. 4.3% in MATLAB (photometric MINISWHITE). Root cause JBA_TA I-023. Affected: vsp/bg/gp runs 2026-11-06..09, pmc J0045 (same mask source).

title: voronoi_area_cv is dominated by unbounded Voronoi cells at the ROI border and is missing above 80 000 cells
affects: build_morphometric_results/extract_morphometric_features: voronoi_area_cv (median ~62 in BG/VSP, r=0.71 with log n_cells) mostly measures border cells whose Voronoi polygons reach far outside the region; NaN for ROIs with > 80 000 cells (systematic, large ROIs)
details: Alexey BG/VSP 2026-11-09: CV 2.7..269; single 130k-cell ROI without cap: CV 172, max Voronoi area 3e10 um2. Proposed: only cells whose Voronoi polygon lies completely inside the region mask (minus-sampling edge correction), no upper cell limit; report n used.
